DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchial Asthma (Post-Infectious/Exercise-Induced)

Based on your obstructive spirometry results, 16 pack-year smoking history, and symptoms of nocturnal cough and exertional dyspnea following a URI, you likely have bronchial asthma. The smoking history also raises concern for early COPD overlap, but the nocturnal pattern strongly favors asthma. Please confirm if you experience wheezing or chest tightness.
